experiences.title: Social Media Analyst
experiences.description: Analyzed social performance across 3+ major platforms, tracking engagement rate, reach, impressions, follower growth, sentiment, and content performance to support weekly marketing reporting. Built campaign dashboards using Sprinklr, GA4, Meta Insights, and Excel, consolidating 10+ recurring KPIs into stakeholder-ready performance reporting. Evaluated organic and paid campaigns through A/B testing and audience segmentation, identifying creative and messaging patterns that improved campaign optimization decisions by approximately 15%. Conducted social listening and competitive benchmarking across 10+ brands/competitors, identifying emerging consumer conversations and content opportunities for campaign planning. Partnered with brand, creative, and paid-media teams across multiple concurrent campaigns, improving content-calendar coordination and reducing reporting follow-up cycles by approximately 20%. Tracked weekly KPI trends and validated campaign metrics before distribution, improving reporting consistency and reducing recurring metric discrepancies by approximately 15%.

experiences.title: Social Media Analyst
experiences.description: Managed corporate social activity across 3 social platforms, monitoring engagement, reach, impressions, follower growth, and content performance to strengthen employer-brand visibility. Developed content calendars supporting employee advocacy, technology thought leadership, events, and employer-brand campaigns, maintaining consistent publishing cadence across multiple initiatives. Consolidated monthly social KPIs using Hootsuite and native analytics, reducing manual reporting effort by approximately 25% through standardized performance tracking. Partnered with HR and Talent Acquisition on employer-brand campaigns, using LinkedIn audience insights to identify content themes aligned with recruitment objectives. Coordinated graphics and short-form video assets across multiple campaign schedules, improving on-time content delivery and reducing publishing delays. Performed competitive benchmarking across the IT-services sector, reviewing 10+ competitor profiles to identify content themes, engagement patterns, and editorial opportunities.
